title: The kernel of any presentation of a finitely presented algebra is finitely generated
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $S$ a commutative $R$-algebra of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Then for every $n\ge0$ and every surjective homomorphism of $R$-algebras $\alpha:R[x_1,\dots,x_n]\to S$ from the polynomial ring in $n$ variables, the kernel $\ker\alpha$ is a finitely generated ideal of $R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$.
